_setup: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) and fill in your own values. No credentials needed: auth is your own `gh auth login`. Every field below is optional — omit one and the skill falls back to a sensible default or auto-detects (branch names default to dev/main; app_dir defaults to repo root; verify commands auto-detect from package.json).

verify._comment: Commands run in app_dir. {file} is substituted for single-file test runs. Omit any to auto-detect from package.json scripts.

deploy._comment: Optional. A background command that watches your deploy and self-notifies. {branch} is substituted. Omit to skip the watch phase entirely.

release._comment: changelog: 'manual' (maintain changelog_path), 'auto' (CI generates notes, skip the manual step), or 'none'. draft: open release PRs as draft for review.
